title: Delay Service State
description: Applies a digital delay effect to an audio pipeline, adding an echo to the signal. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/delay)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

feedback.description: How much of the delayed signal is fed back into the delay line (0–0.999)

mix.description: Wet/dry blend (0 = dry only, 1 = wet only)
